slides.title: GROUP BY = [[gang banao]]
points: Har group pe **COUNT, SUM, AVG** chalao
slides.note: Jaise shaadi mein: ladki wale ek side, ladke wale ek side 💃

slides.title: Dept wise [[hisaab]]
slides.code:
SELECT dept,
  COUNT(*) AS people,
  AVG(salary) AS avg_salary
FROM employees
GROUP BY dept;

slides.title: 5 rows → [[3 groups]]
slides.note: Order guaranteed nahi. Sorted chahiye? **ORDER BY** lagao

slides.title: SELECT ka [[golden rule]]
points: name likha? IT ke **2 naam**, kaunsa dikhaye? 🤷
slides.note: Ek group ki ek row hai, **ek naam** fit hi nahi hota

slides.title: Multiple [[columns]] bhi
slides.code:
SELECT dept, city,
  COUNT(*) AS people
FROM employees
GROUP BY dept, city;
slides.note: Har **(dept, city)** combo ka alag group banta hai 🔥

slides.why: name GROUP BY mein nahi → PostgreSQL/SQL Server **error**, MySQL (strict mode) bhi
